Spray Dried Pineapple Powder for Food and Beverage Production

Pineapple powder brings a bright, sweet and tangy tropical note to products that need a dry, shelf-stable fruit ingredient. Our spray dried pineapple powder is made for manufacturers who want reliable flavour and aroma in every batch. Tradenest Naturals supplies fruit powders that blend easily into drink mixes, confectionery, bakery and dairy formulations. Spray drying turns ripe pineapple into a fine, quick-dissolving powder that is easy to store, dose and ship.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Pineapple Powder?

As a spray dried pineapple powder manufacturer, we know that consistency matters more than anything on a production line. Dried fruit pieces can vary in texture and taste. Our spray dried process gives a uniform powder that behaves the same way from lot to lot. That makes it a good fit for larger industrial runs. The powder also dissolves quickly, which can shorten mixing time in your plant. In practice, that means smoother production cycles and better cost control.

How the Powder Is Made

We start with ripe pineapples carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. First, the fruit is peeled and pressed to extract the juice. Next, the juice is spray dried. Fine droplets meet a stream of warm air, and the water evaporates within seconds. Because the drying is so fast, the fruit spends very little time exposed to heat. This helps keep the fresh flavour, aroma and colour of the pineapple. The powder is then sieved to a uniform 80-100 mesh. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our wholesale spray dried pineapple powder is used in many sectors. In beverages, it goes into instant tropical drinks, smoothies and cocktail mixers. In confectionery, it flavours gummies and hard candies. Bakery producers use it to add fruit notes to breads, cakes and pastries. Dairy companies use it for yogurts, shakes and ice creams. It is also popular in snack seasonings and breakfast cereals. Because it works in so many products, it helps you extend your range with one ingredient.

Quality and Global Export

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter. As a spray dried pineapple powder exporter, we follow hygienic processing practices and keep records that support batch traceability. Moisture and particle size are checked for every lot. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. If you are searching for a bulk spray dried pineapple powder supplier india, we offer steady supply and clear communication. We also provide export documentation support for smooth customs clearance.

Frequently Asked Questions for B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for spray dried pineapple powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This suits trial batches and pilot runs, and larger orders are quoted at volume pricing. Contact us for a quote based on your needs. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, processing)? Our standard powder is spray dried to 80-100 mesh for good solubility. Moisture is kept below 5% to support stability in storage. Full details are given in the product specification sheet. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer bulk bags, HDPE containers and custom stand-up pouches, all made from moisture-resistant, food-grade materials. The shelf life is 18-24 months when stored cool and dry. How do I request a sample? Use our contact form to request a sample or a formal quote. Samples are available on request, and our team will reply with technical details and pricing.
